data.title: 阿尼斯 · 晚风街角便利店冰淇淋与闲散漫步
data.description: 前哨基地夏夜街角的24小时便利店门口，阿尼斯穿着舒适宽大的套头卫衣坐在长椅上。她一边晃着双腿吃着双色蛋卷冰淇淋，刚买的一袋冰镇汽水放在身旁的长椅上，抬头冲你灿烂大笑，享受着毫无烦恼的轻松假日夜晚。
data.location: 前哨基地街角24小时便利店门前长椅
data.action: 坐在长椅上吃冰淇淋晃腿，抬头露出灿烂开朗的大笑
data.lighting: 便利店玻璃幕墙透出的明亮白光与街边暖黄路灯
promptTokens: shopping bag on bench beside her
data.promptProse: Sitting on the wooden bench outside the glowing convenience store, she happily eats a swirl ice cream cone while a plastic shopping bag of iced sodas rests beside her on the bench. Warm streetlamp light catches her bright laugh as she swings her legs into the balmy night breeze.
data.animaCaption: She happily eats an ice cream cone on a bench beside a shopping bag.
